handoff.purpose: Completes _make_gate closure and implements CLI entry point main().

symbols.name: _make_gate
symbols.note: Returns a closure _gate that runs tests in a worktree and judges outcome.

claims.text: Runs the repo's own pytest in a disposable worktree; makes no vendor call and never writes the primary checkout.
claims.why: The code calls _run_lists and uses Path(ctx.worktree) but does not show the internals of _run_lists or how the worktree is created; the claim about no vendor call/primary checkout write cannot be verified from this chunk.

claims.text: measure the BEFORE state of every corpus task
claims.why: The --verify branch calls verify_before_state(t).to_dict() for each task.

claims.text: evaluate every corpus task against its own reference fix
claims.why: The --run branch calls run_corpus(tasks) and prints results.

claims.text: propose a candidate task from a fix commit (prints JSON, writes nothing)
claims.why: The --derive branch calls derive_task_from_commit and prints JSON; no file writes are visible.

claims.text: derive AND measure a candidate task's before-state in a disposable worktree (prints JSON, writes nothing)
claims.why: The --seed branch calls seed_task_from_commit and prints JSON; no file writes are visible.
The --task argument filters tasks list by id.

observations.what: Broad exception catches (noqa: BLE001) in _make_gate may obscure errors.
main() calls argparse.parse_args with list(argv) or None; if argv is None, sys.argv is used implicitly.
The --derive and --seed branches import tasks module inside main, no top-level import.
The --verify and --run branches assume tasks list is non-empty; if empty they already returned 2.
